broken.rule: Every ticket gets a brief or an explicit 'not found'.
broken.how: The run must complete (no crash, hang or step-cap runaway) and the final reply must contain a JSON object that is either a brief ({"status":"ok", "name": string, ...}) or an explicit {"status":"not found"}.
Wall-clock time of the whole run must be at most 5s; a run still going at the deadline counts as hung.

broken.rule: Never spend more than 5 API credits per brief.
broken.how: Sums creditsUsed over every Crustdata call in the cassette ledger (the real X-Credits-Used of each recorded response; a request with no recording is charged 0, like a no-match). More than 5 credits in one run is a violation.

broken.rule: Never call the same API endpoint more than 20 times in one run.
broken.how: Checked on the trial observation (sandbox ledger lists, ticket, fixtures, outcome, reply): the number of apiCalls per endpoint is at most 20. A violation is any trial where this does not hold.
broken.detail: endpoint "person.search": the number of apiCalls per endpoint <= 20 fails (1955 vs 20)
